content_of_post_to_comment:
I am 24; I have long had my information fix. I am somebody who's interests lean into anything creative and physical. Yet, it is this ceaseless desire for noise, news, and nudes, that have first most priority on every decision that I make. I've gotten far in many aspects, I've deleted Youtube and Instagram (my favorite drugs), and yet every variable of life has me come back to them, because I do not have the social support system that encourages the interests that I truly have. I am vexxed and fixated and don't even remember how to engage in life holistically with books and art and fascination. I truly want to find an addiction specialist who deals with literally only this.

I think traditional therapy could be really helpful as well. At this point in time, I do not enjoy the internet and yet I feel emotionally stabilized and trapped by it.
comment: Deleting YouTube and Instagram but feeling pulled back makes sense when those apps are filling a gap beyond entertainment. The harder part might not be quitting the internet, but rebuilding the things it replaced: curiosity, connection, and a place to share your creative interests. Have you tried finding communities around art or physical hobbies where showing up regularly creates that support?
